LESSON: READING 15.4.1 POETRY

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.4: Reading 15.4.1 Poetry

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 15.4.1 Poetry. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why would you use a poem instead of a story to pass information?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the subject matter of a poem

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the subject matter of a poem
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the subject matter of a poem. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 15.4.1 Poetry using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 15.4.1 Poetry in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 15.4.1 Poetry to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 15.4.1 Poetry.
4. Show that you can: identify the subject matter of a poem

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 15.4.1 Poetry using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 15.4.1 Poetry important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss how the use of repetition and other styles can help bring out the ideas in the poem,
2. Problem Solving: It is enhanced when finding extra information as learners search online and offline for ways of determining ideas in a poem.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why would you use a poem instead of a story to pass information?
2. What makes a poem interesting to read?
3. What kind of ideas can one convey using a poem?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the subject matter of a poem

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
